alt: Cover: Priya holding a clipboard. Week 44, 26 October–1 November 2026: last week in one page — 9 stories, 5 facts, 2 likely MCQ angles.

Revision sheet for Week 44 listing 9 UPSC stories with GS paper and Prelims angle: Census 2027 enumeration dates notified; SC lets Maharashtra local polls proceed (Art 243D, triple test); Legislative Councils (Art 169, 171); India's Ramsar sites reach 103; ISRO launches NVS-03 for NavIC; World Bank puts extreme poverty at 2.6%; Cyclone Arnab landfall and floods; social security boards for gig workers; Cabinet clears PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana.

Five facts: Census 2027 reference date 00:00 hours, 1 March 2027 for most of India; a Legislative Council is at most one-third of the Assembly and at least 40 members; Parliament creates or abolishes a Council by ordinary law after a special-majority Assembly resolution; India has 103 Ramsar sites, newest Sukhna and Sauj Jheel; World Bank extreme-poverty line is US$3.00 a day at 2021 PPP.

Two likely MCQ statements with answers: panchayat seats for backward classes only by a law of Parliament — False, Article 243D(6) lets the State Legislature provide it; NavIC is a global navigation system like GPS — False, it is regional. Every story with its UPSC angle: minimalistias.com/week.
